target_audience: Insurance administrators, corporate employers, brokers, and healthcare providers managing policy enrolments and hospital empanelment workflows
emotional_tone: Precise, professional, trustworthy, frictionless, and modern
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY / PERFORMANCE PRO hybrid with clean neutral slate and royal indigo accents

rules.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100
rules.overlines: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400

visual_enhancers.card_style: flat solid surface with subtle 1px border and soft hover lift
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800/50

layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6) with optical alignment and no text collision on bordered containers

motion.transition_rules: Use explicit transitions (e.g. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; DO NOT use transition: all). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and interactive components.

media.images_constraints: Max 80vh height on mobile. Proper responsive scaling.

image_urls.description: Analytics dashboard performance graphs on laptop screen
Medical professionals working together in a modern facility
Employer dashboard showing application trends and metrics

instructions_to_main_agent: Modernize and polish the enrolment-ui frontend located in enrollment-ui/New folder/src with robust accessibility, pristine responsive design, beautiful typography rotation (Plus Jakarta Sans + Inter), enhanced step progress navigation, and intuitive validation feedback.
Ensure all interactive elements and buttons include proper data-testid attributes for reliable end-to-end testing.

Maintain high code quality in .js/.jsx/.ts/.tsx files, adhering strictly to the design system rules, avoiding forbidden colors (#7351B7 and #1B93A4), and ensuring no transparent backgrounds on headers or sticky menus without backdrop-blur.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Always use explicit interactive states and accessible contrast
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
